integrity: Explicit Gaussian integral and dominated-convergence proof; standalone numerical quadrature independently checks sample identities, but finite checks are not proof of the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-exponent asymptotics for normalized Gaussian-envelope cubic-phase signals only; no extension to time-limited chirps, other envelopes, cross-ambiguities, or joint exponent–chirp limits. An earlier equivalent formulation in unindexed literature is possible; no independent publication-priority certification.
title: The fourth-moment transition for cubic-chirped Gaussian ambiguity functions
